svg.text: A chain carries the story from definitions through origins and evidence to causes, then the causes converge and
the piece fans back out into three kinds of response — so this is a chain-into-converge-into-diverge.

g.text: The article moves forward in time (definitions, origins, evidence) into two converging bundles of cause, then diverges

g.text: Two parallel bundles of cause run side by side: problems with how publishing itself works, and problems with the
statistics and research practices underneath each study.
